theme: Dark Mode (Black and Emerald Green with Glassmorphism)

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Apply tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for sizes > 32px.

body.usage: Use for body text, form inputs, tooltips, and labels.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Import these fonts via Google Fonts (Manrope) and Fontshare (Cabinet Grotesk) in index.css. Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard generic fonts.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Override index.css CSS variables with these dark mode values. For the primary action color, use Tailwind's emerald-500. Use dark obsidian black (#050505) for the base body background.

glassmorphism.usage: Apply to dashboard widget cards, sticky headers, modals, and dropdown menus. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for any overlays or headers.

visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle drop-shadows with emerald hues (drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.3)]) on active elements or key metrics to create a premium tech feel.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Do not use full-screen gradients. Use subtle radial gradients (e.g., bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-emerald-900/20 to-background) as background accents.

layouts_and_spacing.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8, p-12) for dashboard panels to avoid cramped views. Use gap-6 or gap-8 in grids.
layouts_and_spacing.grids: Use 'Bento Grid' concepts for the dashboard. Combine col-span-2 and col-span-1 panels to break monotonous symmetry. Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) but generous internal padding (p-6) in widgets.
layouts_and_spacing.border_radius: Subtle roundness: stick to 12px (rounded-xl) or 8px (rounded-lg) for glass panels. Do not use aggressively rounded corners on dashboard widgets.

components.headers: Sticky or fixed with glassmorphism (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Never use transparent background over scrolling content.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or rounded-lg. Primary buttons should be emerald-600 with hover:emerald-500 and a subtle emerald shadow. Secondary buttons should be glassmorphic (bg-white/5 border border-white/10).
components.charts: Use recharts or chart.js. Remove default grid lines or make them extremely subtle (rgba(255,255,255,0.05)). Use the defined green monochromatic chart palette.
components.forms_and_inputs: Inputs should have bg-white/5, border-white/10, focus:border-emerald-500, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-500. Text must be white.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for text. Use text-white for primary text and text-slate-400 for secondary text. Never use gray text on gray backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have clear focus rings, typically focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/50.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='resume-builder-submit').

motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform) with duration-200 ease-out. NEVER use `transition: all` as it breaks transforms.
motion.hover_states: Cards should have a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and increased border glow on hover.
motion.micro_interactions: Entrance animations for dashboard widgets using Framer Motion (staggered fade-up).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
NEVER use generic placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case format.
Ensure the theme defaults strictly to dark mode across all pages.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.
